regime_context: The detector shows a narrowing rotation with 24 of 49 themes trend-eligible, a validated absolute-trend gate, and Big Pharma as the headline with high durability (0.81) but crowded texture (z=1.33), while Memory/HBM leads the rank but fails eligibility (0.35 durability). Momentum rank is a focus lens only (rank-IC ~0), so no directional strength should be inferred from ranking itself.
emerging_watch: Watching Memory, HBM & Storage: if its durability_bar rises above 0.45 while remaining rank-1, that would retire the current read that it is an ineligible leader and suggest the trend gate is reopening for the AI-semiconductor complex.

theses.subject: Big Pharma
theses.thesis: Big Pharma is the only theme combining trend eligibility with the strongest durability leg (0.81), full breadth (1.0), and a trend Hurst tag. The validated absolute-trend gate is the one reliable edge here, and Big Pharma passes it decisively. The crowding flag (z=1.33) is high but only tempers conviction and should not trigger a fade; the theme's internal cohesion (breadth 1.0) is strong. This is a continuing-leadership lean, not a rotation prediction.
theses.dissent: Crowding z=1.33 means the theme is heavily owned; ETF inflows/attention frequently mark local tops, and with no forward edge in the momentum rank itself, continuation is not guaranteed.

falsifier.text: PPH breaks below its 50-day average while breadth narrows below 0.7 before the 20-trading-day check.

theses.subject: Health Care (Equal-Weight)
theses.thesis: Health Care EW is a second eligible healthcare leader with a high durability bar (0.76), trend Hurst tag, and breadth of 0.95. It shares the same regulatory/defensive narrative as Big Pharma but with a broader sector proxy (XLV) and slightly higher crowding z (1.47). The trend-gate leg is the support; crowding is a caution that keeps conviction low.
theses.dissent: The high crowding z sits in the top decile of the sample; if this is a late-cycle defensive bid, both Big Pharma and Health Care EW could stall together as attention rotates.

falsifier.text: XLV underperforms the S&P 500 by more than 3% over the 20-trading-day check window.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
